#
ssh server dh-exchange min-len 1024
#
ssh client publickey dsa ecc rsa rsa_sha2_256 rsa_sha2_512
#
ssh client cipher aes256_gcm aes128_gcm aes256_ctr aes192_ctr aes128_ctr aes256_cbc aes128_cbc 3des_cbc
ssh client hmac sha2_512 sha2_256_96 sha2_256 sha1 sha1_96 md5 md5_96

user-interface maximum-vty 21
#
user-interface con 0
#
user-interface aux 0
#
netconf
 activate module huawei-ip

local-aaa-server

pki domain default
#
set license LCR5S40VA5C00 threshold 50

item.text: 初步配置显示PE1/PE2/PE3组成三角形ISIS/MPLS骨干,而PE2到北京的最短直连应为PE2-PE1。下一步重点核验ISIS实际选路与LDP标签下一跳,并查看PE2-PE3和PE2-PE1链路的接口负载/时延相关状态,以判断是否存在“控制平面绕行但拓扑路径看似直连”的情况。
